request_user:
Fact: training_method
What to find: Main stages and methods of training (pretraining, SFT, preference optimisation/DPO, RL, distillation, merging).
Card sections that often contain it: Training, Training Procedure, Post-training

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset, then post-trained on Dolci datasets in three stages: Stage 1 supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Stage 2 direct preference optimization (DPO), Stage 3 reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR).
quotes: These models are pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset and post-trained on the Dolci datasets.
- direct preference optimization on the Dolci-Think-DPO-7B dataset. This dataset consits of math, code, chat, and general knowledge queries.
- reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards on the Dolci-Think-RL-7B dataset. This dataset consits of math, code, instruction-following, and general chat queries.
